notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bug fix:[/b]
Correction of a problem causing Emily's imobilization in Hector's laboratory.

[b]- Improved game ergonomy:[/b]
Auto-aim is now deactivated after killing an enemy to prevent player disorientation when surrounded.
Simply press the aim button again to target the nearest enemy.

[b]- Widget:[/b]
Fixed visible outline on lantern icon for OLED display.

notes.title: Update 1.0.41
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Improved game ergonomy:[/b]
* Reduced cooldown between quick turns.
* Possibility to return to the aiming position during the transition aiming -> idle / movement animation.
* It is no longer necessary to press the aim input again to return to the aiming position after a hit from the boss Christy.
* Very slight cooldown reduction between rifle shots.
* Having the golden gun in the inventory no longer requires you to collect the basic handgun to access the boiler room at the end of the game.

[b]- Bugfix:[/b]
* It is no longer possible to do quick turn while reloading the rifle.
* Fixed an issue with Amber's animation triggering in the tunnel.

[i]Hotfix: The zombies cutscene is well triggered if the player enters the boiler room with the golden gun at the end of the game.[/i]

tags.balance_change: - Possibility to return to the aiming position during the transition aiming -> idle / movement animation.
- It is no longer necessary to press the aim input again to return to the aiming position after a hit from the boss Christy.
- Very slight cooldown reduction between rifle shots.
- Having the golden gun in the inventory no longer requires you to collect the basic handgun to access the boiler room at the end of the game.

tags.bug: - It is no longer possible to do quick turn while reloading the rifle.
- Fixed an issue with Amber's animation triggering in the tunnel.
The zombies cutscene is well triggered if the player enters the boiler room with the golden gun at the end of the game.

notes.title: Update 1.0.40
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bugfix:[/b]
* It is no longer possible to insert a magazine in the golden gun.
* It is no longer possible to look at your ammo when Emily coughs.

[b]-Sound:[/b]
* Fixed a sound problem that reappeared following a previous modification.
The coughing sound can (really) no longer be heard during the end-game cutscene. 

[b]- Collision:[/b]
* Improved a collision issue in the passage leading to the mansion's balcony.

[b]- Widget:[/b]
* Fixed a syntax issue in a document for the English version of the game. 
* Fixed widget display issue for those playing with a 32:9 mod.
(The game is not natively compatible in this format.)

[b]- Improved game ergonomy:[/b]
* Added a very short cooldown after reloading to avoid wasting ammo by shooting before return to aiming animation.

notes.title: Update 1.0.39
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bug fix:[/b]
* Fixed an issue with camera transition triggering in the back wing lobby of the mansion.
* Fixed an issue that could freeze the player during an interaction with the wine bottles in the basement.
* Fixed an issue causing ablility to move during the cat petting animation.
* Fixed a glitch allowing duplicating Glock magazines.

[b]- Improved game ergonomy:[/b]
* Berserker attacks no longer succeed if the player has interacted with a door, preventing the player from taking unfair damage.

[b]- Widget[/b]
* The Reload option no longer appears in the inventory for the Rifle if the player does not have any cartridges.

notes.title: Update 1.0.36
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bug fix:[/b]
* Fixed a bug causing incorrect interact information after inserted the two swords in the bunker.
* Fixed collision bug with library stairs.
* Fixed a bug giving the possibility for a zombie in the bunker to interact with Emily even when dead, if the player killed him using the gas room while having made the "Critical chance" wish at the fountain.
* Fixed a bug where it could be possible to shoot Cain's lantern in the boiler room when it was not yet placed.


[b]- Improved game ergonomics:[/b]
* Flasks can now be used by double clicking.
* Enlargement of the Cain's lantern hitbox used in the boiler room.


[b]- Others[/b]
* The small suitcase room is opened automatically once the player reaches the end of the game for narrative coherence.
